title: Hollow House
intro: Rain hammers the old house, and the front door will not budge. Wind the stopped clock to break the spell.
win_epilogue: The front door swings open, and you step out into the rain as the house goes dark behind you.

entrance_hall.name: Entrance Hall
entrance_hall.description: Rain streaks the tall windows. A silent grandfather clock stands beside a faded portrait. The library is east.

library.name: Library
library.description: Dusty shelves lean over an old chest. A pale ghost drifts between the books. The entrance hall is west.
library.sounds: Something small rattles inside the chest.

fire_poker.name: fire poker
fire_poker.description: A fire poker is a long iron tool for moving logs in a fireplace. Its hooked tip could lift a stuck latch.

grandfather_clock.name: grandfather clock
grandfather_clock.description: The hands are frozen at midnight. A small keyhole waits in the clock's face.

old_chest.name: old chest
old_chest.description: A heavy chest with a rusted latch, shut tight.
old_chest.alt_description: The chest gapes open, its velvet lining torn.
old_chest.open_refusal: The old chest is stuck shut. A tool may help. Examine it or ask the character here for a clue.

open_refusal_with.fire_poker: You have the fire poker. Try 'use fire poker on old chest'.

winding_key.name: winding key
winding_key.description: A small brass key, cold to the touch.

pale_ghost.name: pale ghost
pale_ghost.description: A pale girl in an old-fashioned dress, flickering like a candle.

dialogue.text: You already have the fire poker. Try using it on the old chest.
'That chest won't open for bare hands,' the ghost whispers. 'There is a poker in the hall.'
The ghost points from the key toward the silent clock in the hall.

interactions.message: You hook the poker under the latch and heave. The chest bangs open around a small brass key.
You turn the key. The clock shudders, the hands spin, and it chimes thirteen times.
